import os,glob,re
def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]; touches=False
                while q:
